prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1472; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in League City, Texas. Can you confirm that you're comfortable being recorded?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe in your own words what happened before the collision.

A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light. I had slowed down a bit because traffic was heavier than usual that afternoon.

Q: Which direction were you traveling, and where were you headed?

A: I was heading straight through, going east. I was on my way home from work.

Q: What did you see as you approached the intersection?

A: The light was green for me. I noticed a vehicle coming from my right side, and I think it was waiting at the stop sign. I didn't expect it to pull out, but it did.

Q: How did the impact occur?

A: The other car pulled in front of me and I hit the brakes, but it struck the driver's side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways.

Q: Were you injured, and if so, what symptoms have you noticed?

A: I've got a stiff neck and some soreness in my shoulders. It got worse the next morning. I went to urgent care and they diagnosed a neck strain.

Q: Have you received any treatment since then?

A: I've been doing physical therapy twice a week and taking over-the-counter pain relievers. My doctor said to expect a few weeks of recovery.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
